In response to repeated failures of centralized detection systems and widespread distrust in official AI oversight, a grassroots coalition of cybersecurity collectives, academic labs, and civic hackers launches a decentralized, open-source monitoring network. While lacking enforcement power, it gains credibility after flagging two minor incidents before official agencies respond.
